Lab recompiled, 46 files, no duplicate. THE CORPUS IS THE RESOLVER FOR DESIGN DETAILS — not Akien. He gets bounds changes, his own sequencing, and spec-changing rulings; everything else derives from the corpus. THE STANDING FIX IS FORWARD STYLE: commit subjects state what changed, not what to do.
